parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate circuits containing resistors in parallel. The first circuit has been set up for you. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1. All numeric answers must have appropriate units. Fig. 3.1

parts.text: (a) (i) Close the switch. Measure the potential difference (p.d.) V across the parallel combination of resistors P and Q. V = ............................................................... Measure the current I T in the circuit. I T = ............................................................... [2] Open the switch.

parts.text: (ii) Calculate the resistance R PQ of the parallel combination of resistors P and Q. Use your readings from (a)(i) and the equation R PQ = V I T . R PQ = ......................................................... [1]

ms.text: correct calculation of RPQ with 2 or more sig figs
